consequence.statement: A new option is available to control the window in which recent metadata results are not cached; nothing is stated to fail if the operator does nothing.

original.statement: Loki adds the `frontend.max-metadata-cache-freshness` option to set the time window for which recent metadata results are not cached.

decision.reason: [ev-bcd6503daa24] only says a new option, `frontend.max-metadata-cache-freshness`, was added to set the time window in which metadata results are not cached. It says nothing fails, is rejected, stops working or must be migrated, so no action-eligible kind is supported. The excerpt gives no default value, so it does not show that existing caching behaviour changes without configuration. That leaves "none" (informational) as the reading the evidence supports.
